Specification: This module is a minimal TLA+ specification whose primary purpose is to exercise top-level ASSUME statements that call TLC printing operators. It extends the TLC module and contains two assumptions, one invoking Print with a boolean value and one invoking PrintT with a string, but it defines no constants, variables, actions, state predicates, temporal specification, or proofs. The file therefore models no transition system or algorithm; instead, it acts as a lightweight test of TLC-side expression evaluation at module load or checking time.
